quotes.author: Patrick Brakefield
quotes.text: That was a great fishing trip! Despite a little breeze and some current, Carl put us on all kinds of fish in several different spots throughout the afternoon. Catching a ton of flounder was a lot of fun. We caught so many fish, I was very satisfied and asked that we head back to the dock before our time was up. The boat and tackle were outstanding. Carl's help and advice were too. It is easy to encourage anyone thinking about a Puget Sound to check with Carl and see what he has available for you.

quotes.author: Chris Piazzoni
quotes.text: Had a great time on the water this past Saturday. We had plenty of bites and the captain put us in the right spots. The boat got a large keeper lingcod early and had a couple other fish we ended up tossing back. Captain worked hard for us and made sure we all had a great time out on the water!

quotes.author: Wesley Christensen
quotes.text: 5 of us had a blast this last weekend with Justin. He knew where the fish would be and had the knowledge to know how to catch them. we ended up with 29 to the boat and 8 more LDRs (Long Distance Releases). We are already talking about booking another trip in the future!

quotes.author: Elsa Erickson
quotes.text: We had such an amazing time with Carl! He had extensive knowledge and the trip was seamless. Carl fileted the flounder once we returned to the harbor which we then got to take home and cook which was awesome. Would highly recommend!

quotes.author: John Kilkenny
quotes.text: Great trip with my father in law. Captain Carl was fantastic and extremely knowledgeable. We all caught our limit! Great experience. Can’t wait to do it again.

quotes.author: Rob Kundysek
quotes.text: Carl is the best. Hands down. Today we went out and were the only boat I saw that limited out Book with Carl, we’ve used them all and he’s the best
